keyFindings.description: When runner_wait returns because the lock names another run, the step shell exits and its EXIT trap (step_at_exit -> typing_stop_at_exit -> typing_stop) sends TERM to typing-<name> and removes the agent token in the other run's runner pod. One line: typing_stop_at_exit returns early when lock_names_other_run.

heap-missing.txt says the step's other files 'were removed from the runner' before runner_step_remove runs; a failed removal is only a stdout note, so the persisted record (collected into the step's tar) is false. README.md:2000 repeats the claim. Write the marker after the removal, from its result.
Comments name replay-prepare as a runner_wait caller (also 1440-1441 and cluster.test.sh:2471); the callers are seed, seed-refs, seed-finish and typing_stop.
The step-gone test is a copy of pg_disk_watch's (1205); one step_gone PID START helper.
runner_step_remove's keep-heap flag has one caller and its own return; two functions, or one with the find form for both.
